component.name: RELICADE
component.summary: Discover and manage community-revived classic games

description.p: Old legends. New life. RELICADE is a launcher in development for community ports, recompilations and recreations of classic games.

Browse projects, keep a local library, manage supported portable installations and choose a launch file. Selected package-bound setup flows help you confirm and import lawful game data. Supported operations include version selection, integrity checks and retained-version recovery.

This Linux x64 development package is not a verified release. Complete catalog setup, gameplay, desktop compatibility and other platform requirements remain under development. Emulation is not implemented. Original game data and BIOS files are not included.
